title: Grateful Dead Live at Grand Prix Racecourse on 1973-07-27
lineage: AudMC stereo> ? > C > DAT > WAV > SHN, unknown taper

ai_review.summary: Excellent audience recording of a rare sound‑check that showcases a celestial Jam and a full‑bodied Bird Song with standout Jerry guitar work.
ai_review.review: This AUD tape captures an informal sound‑check that turned into a monster jam, highlighted by Jerry’s soaring improvisation that many reviewers liken to angels singing. The recording is praised for its fullness, crowd ambience and lack of the harsh cuts found on comparable SBD versions, making it both musically and technically rewarding.

ai_rating.rationale: All 11 reviews are overwhelmingly positive (average 4.8★). The show is described as a high‑energy, jam‑centric performance and the recording is repeatedly called “nice”, “great” and superior to other sources.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Full‑bodied sound with crowd reaction intact; no harsh cuts in Bird Song, ½ Step or Big Jam that plague some SBD versions; clarity improves once the ear adjusts to the tape’s natural ambience.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A relaxed sound‑check/rehearsal set that builds into an expansive jam before segueing toward Wharf Rat, delivering a loose yet captivating flow.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Multiple reviewers praise Jerry’s guitar during the Jam – described as ‘Starship’, ‘angels singing’, and pure‑Jerry brilliance.
